name: Spjass
text: Center starts with the puck in the heel groove, passes with the blade a few centimeters out to the left, spins all the way around and shoots with the blade into the left corner
note: Contacts and arrows read off the puck.no picture (2026-11-10, user: the puck.no pictures are correct). Until then this picture was drawn from the saved trace data/traces/spjass.trace.json (PROPOSED), whose pose and heel pass differ from the picture.
